_comment: Hand labels for the answer stage, keyed by 'question id | first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the reply' (see answer.py). A label applies only to the exact reply that was read. Declines (answered=false) are counted automatically. 'notes' explains every label that isn't 'correct', and one that is.
